thread:
maria (pm-platform): quick sync — we need a concrete dashboard spec for per-route/per-model latency + ttft + tokens/sec so product can sign off on rollout UX. thinking p50/p95/p99 + TTFT heatmap + throughput.

alex (eng-platform): +1. can we keep cardinality reasonable? routes x models x region will explode.

rachel (eng-runtime): runtime can emit these metrics today: `request_duration_seconds_bucket{route,model,region}`, `ttft_seconds_histogram{route,model}`, `tokens_processed_total{route,model}`. labels are currently free-form route names.

jamal (eng-sre): free-form route names = high-card. we need a canonical `route_id` (low-card numeric) and a separate `route_name` tag for UI mapping. prefer storing telemetry with `route_id` + `model` + `region`.

tom (console): for the console panels we want human names and poke-able links to rollout config. UI can map `route_id` -> name via the metadata service. fine if metrics carry `route_id`.

maria (pm-platform): decision: runtime emits `route_id` (string, stable), `route_name` (optional), `model`, `region`, `deployment_tier` (hosted/dedicated/private). Jamal ok?

jamal (eng-sre): ok but drop `route_name` from cardinal metrics. emit `route_name` as label on an infrequent gauge or via metadata endpoint. keep ingestion high-cardinality minimal.

rachel (eng-runtime): implement plan. we'll change histogram buckets for TTFT to cover 0-5s granular and long tail to 60s. will also add `tokens_processed_total` with `batch_size`? we only have `tokens` as delta.

alex (eng-platform): for dashboards, propose the following panel queries (PromQL style):
```
# latency percentiles per route (P50/P95/P99)
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"runtime-.*",route_id=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, route_id, model))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"runtime-.*",route_id=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, route_id, model))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"runtime-.*",route_id=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, route_id, model))
```
and TTFT panel:
```
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(ttft_seconds_bucket{job=~"runtime-.*",route_id=~"$route"}[5m])) by (le, route_id))
```
Throughput (tokens/sec):
```
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total{job=~"runtime-.*",route_id=~"$route"}[1m])) by (route_id, model)
```

alex (eng-platform): panels should support route scoping and model breakdown. default view grouped by `route_id` with small multiples for top N models by qps.

jamal (eng-sre): watch out for `sum(rate(...)[1m]) by (model)` explosion if models are many; recommend `topk(10, sum(rate(...)) by (model))` as default.

metrics-bot: ingest-check: new labels seen on runtime-1 in staging: `route_id="checkout_v2",model="redwood-7b",region="us-west-2"` — cardinality looks ok so far.

maria (pm-platform): UX request from product: a canary heatmap showing P95 delta vs baseline per route during rollout windows. Can console do an overlay?

tom (console): yes — we can add a panel that computes percent delta: `((p95_now - p95_baseline)/p95_baseline)*100` and show red/yellow/green. need a baseline signal; can we have runtime export `baseline_p95` gauge per route when a rollout starts?

rachel (eng-runtime): we can emit a `baseline_p95_seconds{route_id,model}` gauge at canary start. it's cheap.

alex (eng-platform): note: store baselines in a short-lived label set; console will compute deltas with `offset` if we need historical baseline.

jamal (eng-sre): action: create a summarizer job that pre-aggregates per-minute p50/p95/p99 per `route_id,model,region` into a separate TS namespace so dashboards query that instead of raw buckets. reduces query cost. I'll own it.

rachel (eng-runtime): work items for runtime: 1) emit `route_id` label everywhere, 2) add TTFT histogram and buckets, 3) add `tokens_processed_total` with `route_id,model`, 4) emit `baseline_p95_seconds` on canary start. ETA end of next sprint.

alex (eng-platform): console work: dashboard JSON template, panels above, topk logic, canary overlay, small multiples. will include drilldown to route metadata. ETA 1 week after summarizer job lands.

jamal (eng-sre): infra work: summarizer job + retention policy for per-route metrics + alert rule templates (p95 > X ms for >5min). ETA: I'll start a PR today.

maria (pm-platform): blockers?

alex (eng-platform): need a naming convention doc for metric names and label types. created `docs/metrics/routing-metrics.md` stub.

jamal (eng-sre): also need quotas on metrics ingestion from private deployments to avoid high-card spikes. open separate thread for policy.

maria (pm-platform): ok good. action list: Jamal owns summarizer and alerting, Rachel implements runtime labels/metrics, Alex builds dashboard and doc, Tom wires UX overlays. meet Friday @ 10 for signoff. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: deploybot: grafana provisioning applied to staging dashboards for `route_id` test.
